== Westergard finishes differ from the PC coverage ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-08-north-american-continental-championship-new-brunswick-new-jersey-august-9-112024/ PC 2024 NAC coverage] lists [[Chris Westergard]] (Map / Watch Your Step) at #27 and [[Jan Westergard]] (Hoth Combat Readiness (V) / Quiet Mining Colony) at #38. The Day 1 table here shows them at 44 and 45. I've left the finishes as they are until someone checks the final standings.
